__map.learned: Tokenizer: scan number runs of digits/dots, reject >1 dot or no digit; 2-char ops before 1-char.
Parser: recursive descent, unary binds tighter than ^ (atom-level), ^ right-assoc via recursion, range = id : id.
VALUES plain-number regex mirrors tokenizer number grammar plus sign and space padding; errors pass through toNumber
CELLS: isRef is uppercase-only regex [A-Z]([1-9]|[1-9][0-9]); refsOf skips invalid refs and ranges with invalid ends
FORMAT: round via Number(n.toFixed(9)) (guard non-finite and >=1e21), delegate non-numbers to VALUES toText
FUNCTIONS: range args read via ctx.cell (numbers only, first error wins, invalid range #REF!); other args evaluate+toNumber; IF toNumber error on text cond returns #VALUE!
GRAPH: iterative Tarjan over keys plus referenced cells; SCC size>=2 or self-loop is a cycle
TOKENIZER matches spec: num/str/id/op rules, 1e3 split, 1.2.3 and lone dot throw SyntaxError
VALUES matches spec: frozen ERRORS, plain-number regex rejects 1e3/hex/Infinity, parseLiteral keeps TRUE as text
CELLS matches spec: uppercase-only isRef without leading zero, column-major ranges, refsOf walks the PARSER node shapes
PARSER matches spec: precedence levels, right-assoc ^, -2^2 as (-2)^2, empty/leftover tokens throw SyntaxError
FORMAT matches spec: toFixed(9) rounding then String, -0 shows 0, non-numbers via VALUES.toText
FUNCTIONS matches spec: range numbers only, AA1 range -> #REF!, IF lazy with false default, arity checks give #VALUE!
